jobs.occupation: Aircraft Engine Inspector | Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel Region | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:
Jet Engin Inspector wanted for a company in Zaventem. The company is a worldwide leader in design, development and production of aircraft engines. 

As part of the growth (RAMP UP) in LEAP engines, we are looking for an INSPECTOR to strengthen the team.

Your Responsibilities: Perform visual and dimensional inspections on dismantled parts in accordance with applicable procedures. Assess parts (serviceable, repairable, or scrap) using the ERP system and initiate necessary actions. Apply appropriate materials, tools, and methods. Ensure traceability by administratively closing completed tasks. 

Determine the future configuration of parts or modules. Conduct incoming inspections of repaired or purchased parts. 

Carry out final inspections after internal repairs.

 
• You have a superior technical secondary school degree (type A2 in Mechanics, Car Mechanics, Electromechanics...) with a strong foundation in mechanics and proven experience as an aeronautical technician, or a bachelor's degree in aviation with relevant experience in our field. 
 
• You have excellent knowledge of aircraft engines and proven experience as an Inspector. 
 
• You are stress-resistant and take responsibility 
 
• You are flexible can adapt to changing working conditions. 
 
• As an Inspector quality and safety are your priorities. 
 
• You are proactive and can take decisions in urgent situations. 
 
• You have a very good knowledge of technical English, with some knowledge of Dutch or French and you are willing to improve your skills. 
 
• You are willing to work 2 shifts (from 6am to 2pm, and from 2pm to 10pm). 
 
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and supporting your colleagues.

Requirements: 
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium (EU passport or valid work and residence permit). 

Visa or permit assistance is not provided.

Our analytics estate runs on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI: hundreds of workspaces, a large self-service community, and a regulated environment where access control, traceability and data integrity are not optional.

The platform is also moving fast. Copilot and data agents put generative AI in front of business users, Fabric IQ adds an ontology- based semantic layer, and Fabric Apps turn workspaces into a home for real, write-enabled applications each with its own tenant settings, capacity cost and compliance question. Someone has to decide how they get switched on, for whom, and under which controls.

We are looking for an administrator who treats the platform as a product: someone who automates rather than clicks, who can tell you exactly which capacity is throttling and why, and who keeps a GxP-relevant estate auditable without becoming a bottleneck for the business. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a ticket queue.

Responsibilities

 
• Tenant & capacity administration:
  
   
• Tenant settings, domains, workspaces, capacities (F Skus) and delegated capacity settings.
   
• Capacity health and cost: smoothing, bursting, throttling, background vs. interactive operations. Right-size, forecast, and support chargeback to business units.
   
• Onelake, deployment pipelines, GIT integration and CI/CD for Fabric items (Fabric-CICD, Fabric REST APIs).
   
• On-premises and VNET GateWay clusters, connections, and service principal / workspace identity access to source systems (SNOW, Veeva, Edp, ERP).
   
• Incident response and root-cause analysis on refresh failures, performance degradation and access issues; evaluation of preview features before they reach users.
  
 
• Automation & monitoring, the core of this job:
  
   
• Fuam (Fabric Unified Admin Monitoring) as the backbone of tenant observability: deploy it, keep it current with upstream releases, extend it, and turn its output into operational decisions.
   
• Administration automated with PowerShell (Microsoftpowerbimgmt, AZ, Microsoft.Graph) and Python (semantic-link-labs, notebooks) against the Admin, Scanner and REST APIs: provisioning, access reviews, orphaned-item cleanup, licence reclamation, tenant-setting drift detection.
   
• That automation runs properly, Azure DevOps pipelines, Azure Automation/Functions with logging, alerting and error handling.
   
• Observability beyond Fuam where needed: Workspace Monitoring (Eventhouse), Log Analytics, Capacity Metrics, Purview Audit.
  
 
• AI & new workloads:
  
   
• Copilot configuration: the Copilot and Azure Openai Service tenant settings, delegation to capacity administrators, security- group scoping, and the data-residency choices behind them.
   
• The cost of AI: Copilot and agents bill against capacity, so track Cu impact and assess whether a dedicated Fabric Copilot capacity makes sense.
   
• Fabric data agents: who may build them, on which sources, how they are validated, and what changes when they are surfaced through Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or MCP.
   
• Fabric IQ readiness (Ontology, graph, agents) and administration of Fabric Apps workload enablement, operational vs. data apps, the Rayfin CLI, and a review path for anything that writes data back.
  
 
• Governance & compliance:
  
   
• The workspace, domain and naming model, and the promotion path from self-service sandbox to certified content.
   
• Access through Entra ID groups and service principals: least privilege, segregation of duties, periodic access reviews and recertification.
   
• Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels and DLP across Fabric and Power BI items.
   
• Qualification and validation...
  
...

• 5+ years of experience in Microsoft Fabric & Power BI administration

• Strong knowledge of Fabric tenant, workspace, Onelake, F-Sku capacity and GateWay administration

• Hands-on PowerShell & Python automation using Fabric Admin/REST APIs, Microsoft Graph and Microsoftpowerbimgmt

• Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD, GIT, Azure Automation/Functions and monitoring

• Strong expertise in Fabric capacity monitoring, performance, throttling, Cu consumption and cost optimization

• Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, service principals, RBAC, access reviews and security governanc

• Knowledge of Microsoft Purview, DLP, sensitivity labels and audit/lineage

• Experience with Fuam, Log Analytics, Eventhouse and Fabric monitoring

• Understanding of Fabric Copilot, Data Agents, Fabric IQ and AI workload governance

• Knowledge of GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11 and Alcoa+ compliance

Soft skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Proactive and automation-oriented mindset

• Strong ownership and accountability for platform operations

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Strong attention to detail, especially in governance and compliance

• Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions

• Strong incident management and root-cause analysis capabilities

• Ability to balance business needs with security, cost and compliance

• Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing skills

• Comfortable working in a fast-changing technology environment

• Language requirement:

• Required: English (C1 or higher)

• Nice to have: French Or Dutch

jobs.occupation: Handyman / general facilities technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician with solid electrical knowledge and a passion for maintenance, repairs, and problem-solving? Do you enjoy having variety in your work and being the go-to person for all technical issues? And are you already living in Belgium?

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician or handyman to help maintain the buildings, warehouse facilities, technical installations and outdoor areas. A very varied job that combines electrical maintenance, facility maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting and general handyman tasks. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you're responsible for a wide range of maintenance and repair activities across the different sites of the company. You and the rest of the technical team use your technical skills to ensure the operations run safely and efficiently.

Your key duties:

• Perform electrical maintenance and repairs

• Carry out minor repairs to plumbing, storage racks, equipment...

• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities

• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles

• Supervise external contractors and service providers

Your profile:

• Good knowledge of electrical systems and installations

• Basic knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, building maintenance, or general technical repairs

• Experience as a maintenance technician, handyman, facilities technician, general maintenance worker...

• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

• Very good knowledge of English

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium

• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks

• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods

• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You are a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics

• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)

• Can work in a 2-shift system

• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments

• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply!

 

IMPORTANT: this job is only available for people who:

• Already live in Belgium

• Have a valid Belgian address

• Have legal permission to work in Belgium

Housing, relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - Junior Data Engineer (Production & Supply Chain)
jobs.description:
As a Junior Data Engineer - Production & Supply Chain, you help transform operational data into reliable and actionable insights. You contribute to data products, data models, and data pipelines that support reporting, Power BI, Machine Learning, and AI applications.

Working with data from ERP, MES, WMS, and other operational systems, you learn how to structure, integrate, and make data accessible across the organization. Together with BI/RT Solution Partners, Data Scientists, IT teams, and business stakeholders, you help build solutions that improve decision-making across production, planning, inventory, logistics, and quality.
Function

• You support the design, development, testing, and documentation of ETL/ELT data pipelines that transform operational data into reliable datasets for BI, analytics, Machine Learning, and AI.

• You contribute to the integration of data from production and supply chain systems such as ERP, MES, WMS, and other operational applications.

• You help build data products and semantic models covering topics such as production performance, forecasting, inventory management, Otif, planning, traceability, and logistics efficiency.

• You perform data quality checks, investigate data issues, and contribute to maintaining accurate documentation, monitoring, and data lineage.

• You learn and apply modern data engineering practices, including Version Control, testing, CI/CD, and DataOps.

• You work in an agile environment alongside data analysts, data scientists, IT colleagues, and business stakeholders, gradually developing into a well-rounded data professional.

You report directly to the Data & Analytics Platform Architect.

• You hold a Master's degree in IT, Data, Engineering, or a related field.

• You have gained relevant experience through internships, academic projects, or an initial professional experience.

• You have a solid foundation in SQL and Python and are eager to further develop your expertise in modern cloud data platforms such as Azure and Databricks.

• You are interested in data modelling, ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, lakehouse architectures, testing, and documentation. Experience with DBT or similar frameworks is considered a plus.

• You are analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to learn. You enjoy understanding how business processes work and how high-quality data supports better decision-making.

• You are comfortable using AI tools to work more efficiently, accelerate learning, and support innovative solutions.

• You communicate fluently in English and enjoy collaborating with both technical teams and business stakeholders. Knowledge of Dutch a plus.

jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - Information & Knowledge Architect
jobs.description:
At Llbg, we believe that high-quality information is the foundation of better decisions, efficient collaboration, and successful AI adoption. As our Information & Knowledge Architect, you will define how information is structured, governed, and managed across the organization.

You will create the frameworks, standards, and governance models that transform data and content into trusted business knowledge. Working closely with architects, platform owners, and business stakeholders, you will ensure that information is accessible, reliable, compliant, and ready to power future AI-driven solutions. This is a strategic, hands-on role where architecture, governance, technology, and change management come together.
Function

• You define and own Llbg's information and knowledge architecture, including domain models, business glossaries, taxonomies, metadata standards, and semantic frameworks that create a shared understanding across systems, countries, and teams.

• You establish and drive our information governance framework, ensuring clear ownership, stewardship, quality standards, classification, retention, and lifecycle management for both structured and unstructured information.

• You lead master data governance by defining business object ownership, stewardship responsibilities, standards, and governance processes together with key stakeholders.

• You define how information is created, tagged, classified, versioned, stored, and retired, ensuring that content remains trusted, compliant, and ready to support AI-driven use cases.

• You collaborate closely with architects and platform owners to design and implement information models within governance and Microsoft 365 platforms.

• You establish the governance principles and guardrails for AI access to enterprise knowledge, ensuring compliance with GDPR, the EU AI Act, and internal policies.

• You lead by building. For the first AI Knowledge use cases, you are directly involved in the design and delivery, shaping the content model, retrieval logic, grounding approach, evaluation framework, and adoption journey. By leading these initial implementations, you establish the standards, best practices, and reusable templates that future teams can build upon rather than reinvent

• You engage with business stakeholders across the organization to identify, prioritize, and deliver knowledge management and AI-related initiatives that support Llbg's digital transformation journey.

• You lead and coach the AI Knowledge Engineer while driving adoption, change management, and knowledge stewardship across multiple countries and business domains.

• You hold a Master's degree in Information Science, Data Management, Computer Science, Business Engineering, or a related field.

• You bring 8-12 years of experience combining information governance, data governance, and hands-on technical implementation.

• You have successfully designed and implemented taxonomies, metadata models, semantic structures, or governance frameworks that delivered measurable business value.

• You have experience with master data governance in ERP-driven environments; SAP experience is a strong advantage.

• You have the practical capability to build knowledge AI solutions yourself, from preparing and structuring source content to designing enterprise search and RAG-based experiences.

• You understand the technical and operational work behind successful AI adoption, including metadata, retrieval quality, access controls, testing, user feedback, and long-term ownership

• You are familiar with governance and catalog solutions such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, Unity Catalog, or similar platforms, and communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of Dutch is a strong asset.
